fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects execution of wab.exe (Windows Contacts) and Wabmig.exe (Microsoft Address Book Import Tool) from non default locations as seen with bumblebee activity
fields.name: Wab Execution From Non Default Location
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\wab.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\wabmig.exe") and (not (tgt.process.image.path contains "C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\" or tgt.process.image.path contains "C:\\Program Files\\Windows Mail\\" or tgt.process.image.path contains "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Windows Mail\\"))))
